rationale: The full research paper defines accident probability under a base traffic distribution, a simulator and a specified threshold, and explains that estimating the base distribution is essential. This supports the claim's conditional-risk framing and its rejection of an unconditional-safety reading of accumulated test exposure.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-003-R1 — PDF p. 1, abstract and introduction
S-EVID-003-R2 — PDF p. 2, base distribution and simulation inputs
limitations: This is a highway research case study and research preprint, not a regulatory safety case.
The numerical result remains conditional on scenario abstraction, simulator, base-distribution tails and threshold; it does not transfer automatically to aircraft encounters.
